goal: For every social/SEO image request CEREBRO generates, validates and iterates its OWN image prompts, never depends on ChatGPT writing them by hand.

routing_preference.use_for: brief decomposition, brand, formatting, safety and learned corrections
novel visual metaphors, multiple composition candidates, semantic correction when deterministic quality poor
creative concept proposals and structured JSON prompts only if local options insufficient and spending guard approved
legal/financial claims, insufficient quality after bounded correction cycles, owner explicit request

image_provider_not_prompt_reasoner: FLUX consumes prompts and images; the prompt composer and image evaluation remain independent logical motor components.
critical_learnings: Two fully autonomous templates produced real model images but missed owner taste: first no humans, second tiny people among monumental architecture
Do not infer success from valid prompt JSON or successful provider HTTP call
High-quality image-conditioned reference must preserve foreground human scale while permitting novel scenes
Independent actual-image vision QA and editorial acceptance must confirm person scale, gaze, no invented text, brand provenance
go_no_go_requirements: social short noticeable hook not tiny
FINOPS atomic idempotence, cost and archive
successful network handoff receipt and duplicate prevention
PREPROD isolated, rollback and acceptance evidence
next_action: Connect an existing free local language reasoning engine if available; otherwise evaluate capped DeepSeek Flash API only after safe secret and budget; test creative drafts against approved art and independent visual QA. No guaranteed perfect prompts.
